text:
they knocked quedo, very quedo,

a the puertas of the house.

-¿Será algún dream- le dije-

that viene a alegrar your soul?


-¡Quizás! -contestó riendo…

his laughter and his voice soñaban.

Volvieron a llamar quedo

a the puertas of the house…


-¿Será the love?-grité, pálido,

llenos the eyes of tears…

-Acaso- said mirándome…

his voice of pasión temblaba…


they knocked quedo, very quedo,

a the puertas of the house.

-¿Será the death? -le dije…

Ella no me said nada…


and itself quedó inmóvil, rígida,

over the blanca almohada,

the hands as the cera

and the mejillas very pálidas.

translation.title: Balada
